name: orb_gap_combo_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, an overnight gap encodes FII/DII directional conviction formed after previous close; when the 15-minute opening range breakout aligns with the gap direction, it reveals that domestic institutional and algorithmic participants agree with the overnight macro bias. This dual confirmation — gap direction + ORB breakout direction — triggers simultaneous execution from gap-continuation algos and ORB-breakout systems, creating a cascade of aggressive limit-order consumption above/below the ORB boundary that sustains for 30-90 seconds. Volume confirmation filters out low-conviction ORB breaks where algorithmic demand is thin, selecting only bars where order flow imbalance is measurably above the session mean.
core_signal_oneliner: ORB breakout that aligns with overnight gap direction, confirmed by 2-bar persistence and volume surge above 20-min average
